undated.question: Applications with nothing dated against them
undated.why: These are invisible on the calendar and in the week ahead, however live they are.

untagged.question: Applications carrying no keyword
untagged.why: A record nobody has filed is a record no filter will ever surface.

orphanFiles.question: Files not filed under any application
orphanFiles.why: Documents drift; this is what says which ones nothing is pointing at.

orphanLinks.question: Links not filed under any application
orphanLinks.why: The same question for the postings and pages you saved to come back to.

busiest.question: The employers you have the most going on with
busiest.why: Counted across every collection at once — applications, dates, files and links.

unpromoted.question: Matches and postings that never became applications
unpromoted.why: Leads go stale silently; nothing in the list views ever says which.

itemActions.reopenedBody: Back on the open list and counted as owed again.
itemActions.completedBody: It leaves the open lists and counts towards today — nothing is deleted.
itemActions.nowDue: Now due {{date}}, here and on the calendar.
itemActions.copyBody: {{date}} — the copy carries the same keywords.
itemActions.deletedReminder: Gone from the reminders list and from the calendar.

vaultEmpty.keywordsHidThem: The keyword filter above the list is what is hiding them.

boardScan.badAddress: That is not an address I can open.
boardScan.timeout: That board took too long to answer.
boardScan.unreachable: That board could not be reached.
boardScan.browserOnly: {{host}} only shows its listings to a real browser, so it cannot be read from the phone. On a computer the jojo browser extension can read it.

timelineForm.title: Give it a title you will recognise.
timelineForm.date: Pick a date — an undated item has nowhere to appear.

reader.tooBig: That document is {{size}} MB and the reader takes up to {{max}} MB.
reader.gone: The copy of that document is no longer on this device.
reader.empty: Nothing could be read out of that document — it may be a scan.
reader.notConnected: No document reader is connected, so the inside of this file cannot be read. Settings is where its address goes.
reader.noCopy: That record has no copy stored on this device, so there is nothing to read.

jobs.readyBody: Saved under the application it was written for.

boot.corrupt: the saved records could not be read ({{detail}}).
boot.blocked: storage is locked by something else on this device.
boot.unsupported: this device has no storage this app can use.
boot.threw: the store could not be opened at all.

posting.needsReader: This needs the document reader as well as the model — it is what fetches the page. Settings has the address.
posting.empty: That page came back nearly empty. Boards that render with JavaScript send a blank shell to anything but a browser — open it here and save the page instead.
posting.askedTwice: Asked twice, with the same result.

clipboard.tooBigBody: Your records come to {{size}} and Android’s clipboard takes about {{max}} of text. Nothing was copied. Use Transfer to send everything to your computer over your local network.
clipboard.copiedBody: A backup you can paste into a note or a file. The documents you attached stay on this phone — their rows come back without their contents.

receive.declined: Nothing was changed. Scan the code again to receive.
